problems: The wheat bed is only 6 units wide, so its edge shows partway up the card and the darker floor beyond it reads as a brown band across the sky line. The field must run off the card to the horizon.
The ears are fat egg shapes in a sparse grid. They read as eggs or pebbles, not ripe wheat. They should be slimmer and pointed, with thin stalks, standing closer together.

The tail vane is almost hidden behind the wheel and shows only as a small gold corner. The boom and vane need to be longer and larger, with the camera moved a little further round, so the vane clearly sits behind the wheel.

Proportions are wrong: the wheel (about 0.95 across) is nearly as tall as the tower showing above the wheat (about 0.85), so the tower looks stubby. The card asks for a tall tower carrying a much smaller wheel. Fix: shrink the wheel to about 0.7 across and raise the tower so it rises well above the wheat.

The wheat reads as a forest of pointed cones, like little pine trees, not as wheat ears. Fix: make the ears slim ellipsoids on stalks, and tilt each ear along its stalk's lean. The old code tilted the ears around x while the stalks lean in x, so they didn't line up.

The tail vane hangs far back on a thin boom and looks detached from the wheel and tower. Fix: once the wheel is smaller, shorten the boom and keep the vane in proportion, with the strut tying it to the gearbox.
